about: Generated by CheatSheetTest from TeamCode opmodes/BasicDriveTeleOp's Match page (MatchPageExport); do not edit. The Driver Station's Match page in the TeleOp: the header, then rows in the order the TeleOp writes them. Each row shows only when its shownWhen holds; a sample is the row's HTML in one state (the practice readout's is a list of lines). The DS renders the HTML: <big> 1.25x, <small> 0.8x, <tt> monospace; repeated spaces collapse.

rows.shownWhen: A fire is refused by the firing arc: TeleOpConfig.enforceFiringArc is on and the turret or its aim is outside the arc.

samples.aim: <font color="#E53935">●</font> Fire: turn the robot: CELL behind the turret's firing arc (or LOCK and hold Circle)
samples.locked: <font color="#E53935">●</font> Fire: turret outside its firing arc: wait for it to come round to the front

rows.shownWhen: The turret or its aim is outside the firing arc on a robot whose TeleOpConfig.enforceFiringArc is off (instead of arcBlocked).

samples.outside: <font color="#FFB300">●</font> Fire: outside the turret's firing arc: shots may hit the robot

rows.shownWhen: Wrong NECTAR may be in the lane (colorSensor.wrongNectarMayBeIn()): the feed gate is shut to every fire button.

samples.shut: <font color="#E53935">●</font> Fire: WRONG NECTAR may be in the lane: gate shut. EJECT to clear

rows.shownWhen: TeleOpConfig.practiceReadout is on (a practice drill), at the top of the page; each sample is the readout's lines, in order, as an array.

start: PRACTICE: fire a volley to time a cycle
cycle1: <small>cycle best 8.5 · median 8.5 s (1) · pick-up best 3.0 · median 3.0</small>
cycle2: <small>cycle best 8.5 · median 9.0 s (2) · pick-up best 3.0 · median 3.0</small>

rows.shownWhen: Always, unless the turret is locked forward (TurretSubsystem.lockedForward).
Always: the operator's launch-speed trim, in ticks/s (keys are the trim).
Always: IDLE while nothing spins the launcher, SPIN while it spins up, READY at speed.
Always: the lane tracker's count, green while the sensor reads the lane full (keys: the count, "_full" while full).
TeleOpConfig.fullLoadGate holds a fire until the lane reads full.
TeleOpConfig.holdFireAtDownCell holds a fire while the camera sees our CELL down.
Always: our end's CELL as the camera sees it now, else the last reading within 8.0 s and its age, else ? (keys: UP, DOWN, ?, or the last reading and its age in whole seconds, "UP_3s").
Always: the last loop's time, which only the robot knows.
Always: the Pinpoint's state (OK; CHECK while it reads again unconfirmed; LOST; NONE when it is not there; the fault count once it has lost the pose since INIT).
Always, unless the turret is locked forward: the operator's aim trim in degrees, left positive (keys: the trim to 0.1).
Under aimTrim while the aim trim is past 5.0° either way (keys as aimTrim's).
